workspace_mode_policy.description: Default same-style: bind developer to the task named feature branch at project.path (main checkout). Exclusive worktree only when isolation is required.
isolation_required_when: same project already has another active write task_key
main project worktree is dirty with unrelated changes that must not be polluted
confirm_before_dispatch_when: intended_branch missing, ambiguous, or conflicts with current checkout / branch purpose
workspace mode confidence is low (dirty-main vs isolation unclear)
CREATE needed but local master behind origin/master (behind_count > 0) without successful FF_LOCAL_MASTER before CREATE_FROM_LOCAL_MASTER
local base dirty or diverged so cannot safely ff without user confirm
main checkout branch != intended_branch and cannot safely align
prior worktree-transfer or user said land on current branch
workspace_mode_policy.confirm_rule: Agent states its judgment first; if uncertain, ask user; no DISPATCH / create_thread / dispatch_intent until confirmed.
workspace_mode_policy.landing_rule: Code facts must land on a named branch tip; never leave live patches only on a detached exclusive worktree without transfer.
